newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET CONFIRMS DEAL TO BUILD PORCHES.
newsitem.headline: VALMET CONFIRMS DEAL TO BUILD PORCHES.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Valmet Oy's Valmet Automotive Oy unit confirmed on Friday it had signed a letter of intent with German sportscar maker Porche AG to build Porche Boxsters cars at its plant at Uusukaupunki, Finland.
"Manufacturing of the cars is planned to begin in autumn 1997, with over 5,000 cars a year to be produced," Valmet Automotive said in a statement.
"The startup of Porsche Boxster production will not affect Valmet Automotive's other production nor will it affect future cooperation talks," Valmet Automotive said.
Valmet Automotive now manufactures Saab 900 convertibles and Opel Calibras at its Uusikaupunki plant as well as Russian Euro-Samara cars at a separate assembly plant, it said.
In 1996, Valmet Automotive produced about 30,000 cars, it said.
